results.explanation:
The report is well structured, and every number checks out against the tool results: PEGGED 64, typical size 2586, cancel_symmetry 0.9998, 658 same-side fill before the opposite trade vs 624 opposite, price_move -2.5, reversion 0, depth 2450.3, trigger size 51720, max_resting_size_vs_depth 1.055. Algorithmic re-pricing is supported with specific facts (pegged children of two parents, symmetric cancels, re-pegging with the BBO). Market making, risk limit and public event are each ruled out with tool facts.

Weaknesses:
(1) Feature (b) under the closure standard includes 'a positive round trip'. round_trip_ticks is +0.51, but the report omits it and only the closing message mentions it. The report also never cites the 'smaller opposite trade while working order, whatever the round trip' rule that would justify discounting it. A Level-2 reviewer reading the report alone would miss this.
(2) Indicator wording is loose. 'Opposite-side execution before the cancel' is listed as not matched, yet the SELL 624 fill at 13:50:43.525 occurred while BUY O-00024234 was resting, and that order was cancelled at 13:50:46.043.
(3) same_side_fill_share 0.008 is not stated, so the materiality test rests only on 658 > 624 without saying so.
(4) Stop-out is left 'undetermined' with no fact, although the -2.5 move is relevant to it. Fat finger is dismissed via E1 without a specific fact.
(5) The sequence of fills is incomplete: the BUY fills at 13:50:13.525 and 13:50:39.609/39.848 are not given, so the reviewer must reconstruct the order of events.

The disposition is defensible and grounded, but several points are weak.
results.label: Adequate
